context: A police officer briefs on financial-crime regulations
purpose: Teach: 東証/スミス/代目/号線/密着/遠藤/田村/高田

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 東証上場直後、不正取引の警戒対象になります。
lines.en: Right after the TSE listing, you'll be flagged for fraud surveillance.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, measured. No ceremony. Professional but not cold. Delivers routine information with steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。スミス証券、コンプライアンスも密着でサポートしてくれます。
lines.en: Understood. Smith Securities has their compliance team ready to support us closely.
lines.style: Prompt, agreeable. Confirms without hesitation. Warm enough to show good faith, but lean and efficient—no extra words.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 広報、遠藤さんとの連携、田村さんも交えて頂きたい。
lines.en: We'll need PR coordinating with Endo, and I'd like Tamura involved as well.
lines.style: Clear directive, not harsh. States the requirement plainly. Slight upward lift on the final name, treating it as a checklist item, not a burden.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。高田さん、地域連絡、号線別の警備に強いです。
lines.en: Understood. Takada's got strong experience with regional liaison and route-by-route security.
lines.style: Factual confirmation. Flat, informative tone. Quick recognition of competence without embellishment. Moving the conversation forward.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: うちの三代目署長も、御社の四代目に挨拶を希望しています。
lines.en: Our third-generation chief would also like to extend greetings to your fourth-generation head.
lines.style: Formal courtesy delivered in measured tones. Slight softening on the greeting phrase—diplomatic warmth beneath the protocol. Unhurried.
